text:
elaine: Escalating to CS — KiteFin trial can't finish onboarding. Provision API key returns 422 due to region policy (they're in EU but data residency flagged US-only). Trial ends in 7 days, AE worried about renewal. Support ticket 112233. @maria can you take point? :wave:

maria: On it. Can you paste the error payload and any repro steps? I'll pull contract + renewal window.

jake: Logs from support + repro:
```
POST /v1/keys/provision 422
Response: {"error":"residency_mismatch","allowed_regions":["us-east-1"],"requested_region":"eu-west-1"}
Customer action: attempted "auto-provision" via UI, hit validation.
Ticket: 112233
```

ops_bot: Ops alert created OPR-2026-441 (severity: medium) 1: added to queue for regional policy check.

maria: Quick questions: did they sign the data residency addendum? AE @tom?

tom: They signed standard TOS, not the residency addendum. Sales notes said they'd test EU region but legal approval pending. I flagged this earlier.

ben: From infra: our provisioning API rejects requests when account flags residency_unapproved=true. We can do a scoped workaround: if AE/CS confirms business case and legal ok, we can enable a trial override for 72h: `POST /internal/overrides  {"org":"kitefin","override":"region_eu_trial","ttl":259200}`. Needs CS+AE+legal signoff.

maria: Comms plan (draft):
- Immediate (0-30m): Elaine to ping customer with acknowledgement and ETA, offer temporary demo environment in US to continue onboarding steps that don't touch production EU data.
- 1h: AE Tom to confirm contractual path + loop legal for residency addendum.
- 3h: Ben to stage EU trial override in a sandbox; Ops to log change.
- 24h: Enable full EU trial if legal ok, run enablement session and record.
- 48h: Post-session validation and renewal status update in CRM (mark "pending-legal-approval").
Note: If legal declines, offer migration plan + credits.

elaine: Called their admin (marc@kitefin.co) — he can accept a US demo for now but insists EU must be available before trial ends. He's open to a 72h override if we guarantee no EU production data is processed.

legal_bot: Noted. Legal to review residency addendum; expect initial response in 8 business hours. Please include contract id KITE-2026-9001.

maria: Owner: maria (CS). Action items: tom (contract path), ben (sandbox override), jake/elaine (customer comms). I'll set renewal flag to "at-risk" until residency confirmed.

ben: Spun up sandbox override in staging and tested provisioning flow — succeeded. Snippet I used:
```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/overrides \
  -d '{"org":"kitefin","override":"region_eu_trial","ttl":259200}' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer INTERNAL-SVC-TOKEN'
```
Will not apply to prod until legal ok.

elaine: Shared US demo link and temporary API key with Marc. He tested basic flows and can proceed with onboarding checklist except EU-only features.

tom: Opening CR with legal for the addendum and cc'ing finance for a credit note if we need to pause billing during remediation.

maria: I'll schedule a 45m enablement session to cover EU plan and feature parity. Options: tomorrow 09:00 or tomorrow 16:00 CET. Elaine — which does Marc prefer?

elaine: He picked tomorrow 09:00 CET. I'll send invite and add meeting record request.

ben: Ready to apply prod override if legal signs off. If they need earlier cutover we need AE approval + Ops on-call present.

maria: Closing the support->CS escalation for immediate triage. CS handoff items: apply sandbox override (done), schedule enablement (done), legal loop (in progress), mark renewal at-risk. Will keep thread open until post-session follow-up and CRM update. Good work team :thumbsup:

jake: Moving ticket 112233 to `cs:triage` and adding note "residency pending legal". Will reopen if legal declines.

elaine: After session I'll upload recording + a short checklist for production EU readiness. Will drop artifacts here.

maria: Final note for AE: label account `risk:residency` and plan 1:1 renewal talk after legal clears. Leaving thread open until CRM updated (48h).
